title: Binance Options Will Launch BTCUSDT Weekly Options
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Options will launch BTCUSDT Weekly Options on  2022-10-20 .   Please note:   BTCUSDT Weekly Options are European-style Options contracts. Binance will list BTC-221028 and BTC-221104 Weekly Options on  2022-10-20 . Thereafter, a new BTCUSDT Weekly Options contract will be listed every Thursday. Please note that there will be no new BTCUSDT Weekly Options listing on Thursdays if the new listing’s expiration date coincides with that of the existing BTCUSDT Monthly or Quarterly Options contract. The existing BTCUSDT Monthly or Quarterly Options contract will be considered as a weekly expiry instead. Separate announcements will be made for the launch of BTCUSDT Monthly and Quarterly Options contracts.  There will be a maximum of three BTCUSDT Weekly Options contracts listed at any time.  Please refer to  Binance Options Contract Specifications  for more details.  Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. Thanks for your support!
